episodes.title: Episode 302: The Cult at Sarah Lawrence College Part 2
episodes.description: In Part 2 we'll discuss each of the cult members' breaking points, how they got away, and how Larry Ray was his own undoing.

episodes.title: Episode 301: The Cult at Sarah Lawrence College Part 1
episodes.description: After their freshman year of college, a friend group decided they'd all live together for their sophomore year. Early into the year, one of their roommates, Talia Ray, informed the house that her father was getting out of prison and she was so excited for him to finally visit. When Larry Ray first arrived, it seemed like he made a real positive change in some of their lives with his advice and guidance. However what followed was a decade-long web of conspiracy, emotional turmoil, psychological and physical abuse.

episodes.title: Episode 181: Heaven's Gate Cult
episodes.description: In 1997, 39 members of a religious sect were found dead by suicide inside a San Diego mansion. Leaders Marshall “Herf” Applewhite and Bonnie Nettles promised that an extraterrestrial spacecraft would take them all to the heaven, or as they called it, “The Next Level”.
